# TestStudy2020Mini

A truncated, self-consistent fixture study modeled on Baker2017Rational/exp1,
used by `tests/test_dataset.py`. Not a real dataset.

- `exp1/` — 3 trials, 2 instruction screens, 1 condition (`block_randomization`
  present).
- `exp2/` — same shape, but `experimentFlow`'s condition omits the
  `block_randomization` key entirely (Gerstenberg2015How-style).
